scene: You climb up into an airy treetop observatory full of brass gadgets.
picture: Side view of a level wooden observatory floor up high among leafy branches. On far left stands a brass telescope aimed outward. Centre left, the dark-haired boy in green stripes holds his skateboard near a humming vacuum-tube radio on a desk. On the right, a pedal-powered wicker helicopter rests on a launchpad.
shown: A large brass telescope mounted on a tripod sits on the far left.
A glowing vacuum-tube radio hums softly on a table at the centre.
A pedal-powered wicker helicopter rests on an open launchpad on far right.

variants.scene: Warm lanterns glow inside a cozy domed treehouse high in the branches.
You arrive in a breezy sky workshop, still searching for {quest}.
Star charts and strange flying machines fill this secret leafy treetop hideout.
